newsitem.title: USA: Confirmation hearing set for US Justice's Klein.
newsitem.headline: Confirmation hearing set for US Justice's Klein.

text.p: The Senate Judiciary Committee said on Tuesday it will conduct its confirmation hearing on Joel Klein to head the antitrust division of the Justice Department on April 29 at 3 p.m. EDT (1900 GMT).

Senate Judiciary Committee Chairman Orrin Hatch, a Utah Republican, has spoken favorably in the past of Klein. With Hatch's backing, Klein is expected to win confirmation from the full Senate after the committee review.
